subject.title: [Feature]:Add configUrl and configButton support in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should OpenClaw let SKILL.md metadata expose a clickable dashboard configuration action, and if so what URL/action trust policy should govern it?
rationale: The requested capability is plausible, but it creates a public skill metadata contract and a dashboard URL trust boundary that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add a typed config action
options.body: Define a typed `metadata.openclaw` configuration action with explicit URL validation, trust labeling, docs, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Reuse existing surfaces
options.body: Keep `homepage` and Skill Cards as the supported discovery links for now and avoid a new dashboard action contract.

options.title: Move to ClawHub/plugin settings
options.body: Require configuration entry points to be expressed through ClawHub or a future plugin settings surface instead of raw SKILL.md fields.

recommendation.title: Add a typed config action
recommendation.body: Define a typed `metadata.openclaw` configuration action with explicit URL validation, trust labeling, docs, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The highest-risk choice is the dashboard action and URL-opening policy, and recent history ties shakkernerd to the relevant Control UI and URL-safety surfaces.
